_note: combat v2 prototype numbers. Each top-level key is shaped like a future balance key. Live values (2026-10-18 snapshot) are marked in v2_meta.live_keys; every other number is a PROPOSAL to tune. Change numbers here, not in code.

v2_meta.sources: combat-stats-8-model, combat-effects-library, combat-roles-draft, combat-audit (2026-10-18), Nathan's v2 decisions (2026-10-18)
v2_meta.tuning: Tuning pass 2026-10-18 (Nathan approved the 6 recommendations): see discord-card-ideas/v2sim-tuning-2026-10-18.md. node run.mjs targets measures every target.

v2_asc._rule: ASC-3: CP = base[r] x (1 + (top[r] / base[r] - 1) x curve[stars]) x cp_mod

v2_level._rule: 1 point per level. Convergence D: CP' = CP + D x (level / max_level) x (target_cp - CP). D = 0 is off.

v2_support._rule: support amounts x F, F = (CP_base / power_ref) ^ power_exp (rarity and stars scale the numbers). Basic attack = basic_x x CP.
v2_support._area: Support area smite (P3, Lab item): the smite hits the target, the area value hits every other foe (true strike). With one foe (the Hunt) the area adds area_one_foe_x of its value to the smite (the plan rule for an area active, the same as cleaver.hunt_area_x).

v2_speed._rule: every unit adds speed to its meter each clock step and acts at 100. speed = base x (1 + 0.03 x SPD points) x statuses. Enemy speed 100 = one action a step.
v2_speed._tuning: Supports 20-24 (8-stat study start ~40 made 1A+7S best). Flurry 18 (was 20: role value x1.16). Tuned 2026-10-18.

v2_charge._rule: the active is ready after N own turns that did not use it (a cycle of N + 1 turns). Charge resets at the start of each fight.

breaker.text: Hits ignore 30% of Defense and deal x1.5 to shields.

flurry.text: Each basic attack has a 20% chance of a second strike at 50%.

finisher.text: +40% damage to a target below 30% HP.

survivor.text: Heals 15% of the damage it deals (max 8% of its max HP a hit).

cleaver._tuning: hunt_bonus 0.10 -> 0.05: teams test P2, Nathan approved 2026-10-18 (Spin to Win was #1 in 3 contents)
cleaver.text: Basic attacks also hit every other foe for 60%. Hunt (one boss): +5% damage, and an area active adds 20% of its area value.

warden.text: Allies take 8% less damage while it stands. Enemies pick it twice as often.

medic.text: After each of its actions, heals the most hurt ally for 5% of its max HP.

controller.text: Its debuffs ignore 50% of enemy resolve and last 1 step longer.

spotter.text: Its basic attack Exposes the target 15% for 2 steps.

herald.text: Its basic attack also Empowers the strongest attacker +15%.

artillery.text: Its basic attack deals 25% (not 18%) and cannot miss.

v2_role_map._rule: role from today's ability kind (roles draft). Overrides: no-ability cards (roles draft table) and 3 Cleavers (effect library 5.1: Talonflame).

v2_status._rule: durations in clock steps. dur = on an enemy, dur_card = on a card (cards act less often). Ticks happen at the end of each step and pass Defense and Exposed.

empowered._stack: false = a new Empower replaces a lower one (today's rule). true = Empowers add up to stack_cap (+50% = x1.5): the P4 what-if of the teams test (a Combat Lab item). Default false.

v2_control._rule: ONE immunity for the whole control family (stunned, frozen, sleep, paralyzed). It starts when a control status ends.

v2_enemy._rule: Hunt boss per tier: HP and ATK live. def/evasion/resolve/keen/speed proposed (8-stat study section 4). Mythic speed 110 with ATK x0.91.

purify.text: Every 3rd action it removes all its negative statuses.

ironhide.text: Unless Marked, cards have x0.7 of their crit chance against it.
ironhide._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-21 (E7 follow-up): the Lab sets the number (combat_v2_monster_tuning.sql). Was: no crit unless Marked (Crit Chain x0.01 on the guardian).

shatter.text: Its hits deal x2 to shields.

regrowth.text: Hunt boss: heals 0.4% of the reference HP each step. Dungeon foe: 0.7% of its max HP each step. No x2 below half. Burn halves it.
regrowth._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-19 (monsters-v2.md 9.4): boss 1% x2 below half -> 0.4% flat, foes 1% flat. Nathan approved 2026-10-21 (E7 follow-up): the Lab sets the number (combat_v2_monster_tuning.sql). Foes 1% -> 0.7%.

frost_aura.text: Its single hits Chill the card 1.

unstoppable.text: Control on it fails 90% of the time.

venom.text: Each single hit has a 35% chance to Poison the card 1.
venom._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-21 (E7 follow-up): the Lab sets the number (combat_v2_monster_tuning.sql). Was: every single hit (Cleave x0.24 on the guardian).

burning.text: Its single hits Burn the card 2.

sunder.text: Its hits ignore 50% of card Defense.

slowing.text: Each area hit has a 40% chance to Slow the card it hits.
slowing._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-21 (E7 follow-up): the Lab sets the number (combat_v2_monster_tuning.sql). Measured on the Hunt boss (Slowing is a Hunt-only mechanic). Was: every area hit.

elusive.text: Marks on it fall off at its turn.

steadfast.text: Takes 40% less until it has 3 different negative statuses.

dispeller.text: Empowered and Exposed work at 10% against it.

v2_enemy._boss_hp: Hunt boss HP = tier HP x asc3_hp_x x the boss hp_factor (Nathan approved 2026-10-19, 9.3). asc3_hp_x 1.7 is a first proposal. hp_factor = the measured median Hunt damage vs the neutral boss (mean of casual and active, run.mjs monsters, 2026-10-19, with the counter moves; Nathan approved). weak_role_x: a "Weak to: role" week, cards of that role deal +50% (9.6; 0.3 until the E7 follow-up: Nathan chose 0.5 from the Lab table of PR #463, 2026-10-21). counter_cut_min: a Normal or Heroic boss may cut a team to x0.65 at most (9.2), a check in run.mjs monsters.
v2_enemy._weak_role: A "Weak to: role" week: cards of that role deal +weak_role_x. weak_role_rules overrides a role: a Controller week boosts control, not damage (Nathan 2026-10-19): damage_x 0, and each control of a Controller on the boss lasts control_add more boss action.
v2_enemy._counter_cap: The counter cap (counter_cut_min x0.65) applies to the Normal and Heroic Hunt boss only (Nathan 2026-10-19). The Dungeon guardian is the hard final room, so the cap does not apply to it. counter_cap_accepted = team/boss Hunt pairs that Nathan accepted as edge cases: Field Hospital vs the Patch-Note Hydra (x0.62, its designed weakness) and Open Season vs the Rage-Quit Warlord (x0.65, on the line).

v2_dungeon._rule: live floor plan: 5 rooms, room 1 fight, room 5 guardian, rooms 2-4 by room_weights. Foe stats = monster x growth x kind x hp_x/atk_x (v2 tuning).
v2_dungeon._tuning: Foe speeds 50 (not the 8-stat study 100): a 5-card squad then makes about one attack for each foe action, as today.

moves_v2._rule: monsters-v2.md 3.1 (plan 8.3): the status moves of the 10 monsters. on = the renamed moves replace the old ones (Nathan approved the monsters, 2026-10-19). Ooze Acid Spit (poison) and squid Ink Blast (curse) already apply their status.

hellfire.text: Hellfire: a heavy hit (1.5) and Burn 2 on the hit card.

frost_punch.text: Frost Punch: 0.45 ATK and Chill 2 on the hit card.

squeeze.text: Squeeze: 0.45 ATK and Blinded on the hit card.

infect.text: Infect: 0.35 ATK, Poison 1 and no heal for 4 steps on the hit card.

monster_passives._rule: monsters-v2.md 3.1 "Passive at elite+": the monster's own passive takes the first passive slot of an elite, miniboss or guardian (the other slots stay random). kinds = where it appears. pack = the raptor Swarm aura in hordes. on = true (approved 2026-10-19).

passive_params._rule: Numbers of the new Dungeon passives (not counter mechanics of the teams test, so they are not in v2_enemy.mechanics).

bulwark.text: Every 3rd action is a Guard (18% of its max HP).
bulwark._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-21 (E7 follow-up): the Lab sets the number (combat_v2_monster_tuning.sql). Was every 2nd action, 20%.

plaguebearer.text: Each Poison tick on it puts Poison 1 on a random card.

undying.text: Revives once at 15% HP, unless Burning or Poisoned.
undying._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-21 (E7 follow-up): the Lab sets the number (combat_v2_monster_tuning.sql). Was 25%.

volatile_core.text: On death: 0.5 ATK to every card, unless it is Stunned or Frozen.

v2_gauntlet._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-19 (monsters-v2.md 9.4): foes x0.4, growth HP x1.15 / ATK x1.07 a floor, rest heal 80% / revive 50%, choice heal 60%, rest and choice weight 20, 10 floors (was 12). Other room weights: the Dungeon values.

v2_builds._rule: weights for spending level points (largest remainder, max 10 a stat). Used for the fixed-build experiments.

v2_pp._rule: 1 PP = +2.5% of the card's expected damage per own turn (effect library 2.1). An attacker active that fires once per cycle C turns and adds V basic hits costs 40 x V / C. Support mains use the library prices at a cycle of 2 (x 2 / C). Rider value = status_pp x chance x strikes / C (attackers) or x 2 / C (supports).
v2_pp._cure: cure = 0 PP: the cure and its immunity are free (Revision 5, Nathan approved 2026-10-18). A support area block costs smite x area x ref.foes_other.

ability_v2._rule: The price-model numbers of the ability blocks beside v2_pp (PR E6, balance ability_v2: one number, one home). pp.att_k: an attacker block costs att_k / C x the basic hits it adds (C = v2_charge + 1). pp.sup_cycle: a support library price x sup_cycle / C. pp.sup_vs_k: the support x-vs-status factor (10/3; not read since PR T1b, a balance leaf is never removed). pp.vs_smite (PR T1b, measured by run.mjs shares): the raw value of x times the damage on a support smite, per smite price x the smite x (x - 1). pp.line_status: the PP of each status of an execute list. pp.quicken_all_x: quicken on every attacker. silver: the Silver upgrade (plan 5.3: + pp PP at stars stars). limits: blocks, riders and the card text words (Nathan 2026-10-20: 6 to 20). k1_shield: the shield of the Glossary cure keyword. share (PR T1, Nathan 2026-10-20 decisions 1 and 2; measured by run.mjs shares, 2000 runs, seed 1): the share of the actives where a condition is true (self_has, enemy_charging, foes_alive, self_shield: the condition costs the block it gates x (share - 1), so the pair costs the block x share) and on_kill (an attacker active downs its target while another enemy stands: the trigger costs like on_crit with this share). ref.per_ally: the mean number of other standing attackers at an attacker active (the scaler per_ally). PR T1b (Nathan 2026-10-20, the 6 approved recommendations; run.mjs shares, 2000 runs, seed 1): share.self_has_each = one share for each card status (share.self_has, the T1 single share, is not read since T1b); share.area_payoff = the share of the other enemies with a status / the share of the main targets with it at the area actives (a payoff also counts on each area hit: x (1 + area x ref.foes_other x area_payoff)); ref.list_extra = the share that each added status of a list ("any of") adds to the share of its condition, at most 1. limits.min_share (Nathan 2026-10-20, approved after PR T1b): the validator refuses a condition whose measured share is below this number (a gate: self_has with the share of its status, enemy_charging, foes_alive, self_shield; the trigger on_kill); such a block costs almost 0 PP and almost never works.

v2_templates._rule: the placeholder UNIQUE ACTIVE of a card = one template of its role, chosen by hash(subject key) mod the role's template count. Numbers fill the 10 PP budget (check: node run.mjs pp).

v2_auto._rule: The Auto button (policy auto). hold_control_for_charging: a support whose main status is a control waits for a Charging enemy (a Hunt boss, or a Dungeon foe with a Cataclysm), for at most hold_max ready turns. Default false (today's Auto).
v2_auto._best: best_holds_control: the policy best (the teams test) holds a control active in the Hunt until the boss is Charging (today's rule, true). false = it uses control at once (a measurement switch).

v2_bosses._rule: The 16 Hunt bosses of monsters-v2.md (2.1, 2.2; names of 9.7). A boss = Resists (immune statuses) + signature rules (sig) + Mythic rules + counter moves (counter_share of its normal turns, the rest is the base table) + hp_factor. The Dungeon guardian "with the same mechanics" uses resists, rules, params and stats, not the counter moves. Rule numbers: v2_boss_rules. _approx = what the simulator runs instead of the design.

netcode.name: Netcode Mutant
netcode._approx: Nathan 2026-10-19: its rule alone counters Artillery. The counter moves are generic (a hit, an area hit, a heavy hit): the smite moves (Rollback heal, Hitbox Desync, Mirror) and Ping Spike took Party Games to x0.44. hp_factor 0.87 measured with these moves.

warzombie.name: AFK Warzombie
warzombie._approx: Undying (Mythic: revive once at 25% unless Burning or Poisoned) never fires in a Hunt day (the boss does not fall). Its counter move Undying runs as: for 8 steps, each card heal also heals it 10% of that heal.

pumpkin.name: Patch-Day Pumpkin
pumpkin._approx: Rollout (Mythic add) runs as Weakened 30% on every card at each Cataclysm. Hotfix: a cure cannot remove that Weakened.

lagspike.name: Lagspike Parasite
lagspike._approx: It resists every control, so Desync and Rubberband rarely matter. Rubberband: after a blocked control it acts again (once a step).

zerg.name: Zerg-Rush Queen
zerg._approx: Brood starts at 5 stacks a day (5 is also the cap). A hit by a Cleaver card or a Burn tick removes 1. The Brood move adds 1. hp_factor 0.57 is the proxy value (Brood was not built when it was measured).

hydra.name: The Patch-Note Hydra
hydra._approx: Cauterize risk is a display rule (Burn halves its heal, as for every heal), so the Hydra has 3 counter moves.

v2_bosses._guard: A boss Guard (Rattle, Dig In, Ice Wall, Hold: "Guard 10%") is 10% of boss_heal_ref (300), not of the boss max HP: the Hunt heals use the same reference (a guard of 10% of 136,000 HP would block a whole day).
v2_bosses._tuning: Nathan approved 2026-10-19 (the counter cap x0.65): Hydra Regrow 3% -> 1.5% and Regrowth 0.6% -> 0.4%; Netcode loses its Rollback heal move; Grind Vampire Bloodrot rule 40% -> 60% and its Bloodrot move 10% for 8 steps -> 40% for 4 steps; AFK Warzombie Infect no-heal 8 -> 4 steps and its Undying echo 25% -> 10%. Netcode: all 3 counter moves are generic (Nathan 2026-10-19).
v2_bosses._weak_to: weak_to = the "Weak to" rule tags of the boss card (Nathan approved the 16 primary role tags 2026-10-21, ui-audit E7-weak-to). The fight reads the first role: tag (makeBoss; SQL combat_v2_hunt_boss reads hunt_bosses_v2.weak_to): one source.

v2_boss_rules._rule: Numbers of the boss rules (signatures, Mythic adds). A rule that changes the cards (bloodrot, brittle, time_lock) works while a unit with it stands. A rule that changes hits on the unit (rollback, mirror_hide, plated, fade) works on that unit.

rollback.text: Smites on it deal 50%. Artillery basics on it deal 18% and can miss.

bloodrot.text: Card heals and lifesteal work at 60% while it stands.

brittle.text: Card shields work at 40% while it stands.

time_lock.text: Quickened does nothing while it stands.

mirror_hide.text: Second strikes (Flurry) and splash or area hits on it do nothing. Multi-strike actives deal x0.7. The reflect is not modelled.

tilt.text: A debuff that it blocks (immune or resisted) Enrages it x1.4 for 2 steps.

siphon.text: At the end of each step it heals the HP that the squad healed in that step.

crush.text: A hit card also takes 50% of the shield that the hit removed.

rubberband.text: After a control on it is blocked, it acts again (once a step).

undying.text: Revives once at 15% HP, unless Burning or Poisoned.

rollout.text: At each Cataclysm, Weakened 30% on every card.

swarm.text: Its area hits deal x2 to support cards.

brood.text: Takes 6% less per Brood stack. A hit by a Cleaver card or a Burn tick removes 1.

permafrost_heart.text: A Chill applied to it comes back to the card that applied it (the same stacks).
